steps.headline: Your Home screen
steps.body: Home is where every job starts and where you see what is happening.
steps.narration: This is your Home screen. It is where every job starts, and where you see what is happening.

steps.headline: Notifications
steps.body: Tap the bell to see updates, like a new proposal.
steps.narration: Tap the bell at the top to see updates, like a new proposal on your job.

steps.headline: Post a job
steps.body: Tap Post a job to describe the work you need.
steps.narration: The big card below says Post a job. Tap it whenever you need something done.

steps.headline: Book a service
steps.body: Or tap a service, like plumbing or cleaning, to start with it chosen.
steps.narration: You can also tap a service, like plumbing or cleaning, to start with it already chosen.

steps.headline: Active jobs
steps.body: Your jobs in progress are listed here. Tap See all to open My Jobs.
steps.narration: Your active jobs are listed here. Tap See all to open My Jobs.

steps.headline: Messages
steps.body: Open the Messages tab to chat with a provider about a job.
steps.narration: The Messages tab is where you chat with providers about your jobs.

steps.headline: Payments
steps.body: Open Profile, then Payments, to see what you paid, what is held and what was refunded.
steps.narration: Open Profile, then Payments, to see what you paid, what is held, and what was refunded.

steps.headline: Take the tour
steps.body: Tap Take the tour any time to see these steps again.
steps.narration: If you ever feel lost, tap Take the tour to see these steps again.
